pairwise_preference.note: Simulated jurist prefers legally-relevant neighbors. Rate > 0.5 means majority of decisions have at least one legally-relevant neighbor in top-k.

cluster_coherence_rating.note: Simulated jurist rates clusters by branch coherence. High branch purity = legally coherent clusters. High language purity = language-dominated clusters.

zoom_task.note: Simulated jurist zooms from coarse to fine clusters. Improvement in branch purity means zoom reveals more specific legal structure.

cross_language_retrieval.note: Simulated jurist searches for cross-language legal equivalents. Recall > 0.2 means at least 1 in 5 cross-language legal equivalents appears in top-10.
